mapper.select: select * from t_heart_beat_record where project_path = #{projectPath} and server_ip = #{serverIp} and process_no =#{processNo}

SELECT * FROM t_heart_beat_record
AND heart_beat_time::DATE >= #{query.startDate}::DATE
AND heart_beat_time::DATE <= #{query.endDate}::DATE
AND (project_path ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keywords}, '%') or server_ip ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keywords}, '%') or process_no::TEXT ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keywords}, '%'))
order by heart_beat_time desc
